title: Rappler Recap: Rodrigo Duterte attends ICC hearing for first time
summary: Justice reporter Jairo Bolledo gives a rundown of the September 16 hearing in this recap

blocks.text: Justice reporter Jairo Bolledo gives a rundown of the September 16 hearing in this recap

MANILA, Philippines – Former Philippine president Rodrigo Duterte appeared in person for the first time during the International Criminal Court’s third status conference hearing of his crimes against humanity case on Wednesday, September 16.
Duterte was arrested on March 11, 2025. His trial will begin on November 30, 2026.
Rappler’s justice reporter Jairo Bolledo gives a rundown of the Wednesday hearing in this recap. – Rappler.com
